call_purpose: Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option, which had been off, in your form settings and saved it.
Following our guidance, you filled in a test form with your other email, and you confirmed the autoresponder email arrived and is now working.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so it is good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in Settings in the email domain section.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in Settings, in the email domain section.
